title: Getting the address right
transcript:
Customer: Can you update the address for my next delivery?
Agent: You can securely edit it in your account settings before dispatch.
Customer: I've updated it there.
Agent: I see the new address is saved for the next order.
Customer: Perfect, that's all I needed.

key_points: Customer updated the address and agent confirmed it is saved.
expected.resolution_details: Customer updated the address and agent confirmed it is saved.
